test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd letter-cluster.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54c9d52205610f923e1e91b9920dcb4c09ca0ead56ef220130741de93e664bcf.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First and second letters ⇒ The difference between the position value is (1).
 
• Second and third letter ⇒ The difference between the position value is (3).

So,

 
• KIO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25649d5c459d621d5cf7642da9c31fcf1e41770eb51b6586be8aec2f15dd4d09.png] 

 
• DEH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9804a7afe246792171fbbd7e897141cc0d5e77670282282a32469506b6fab049.png] 

 
• WXA

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/426798270edb0dfe588fc60c5e7e260d96c82ee2178ede567861a1763ebe5db1.png] 

 
• NOR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0b312ecaa9460bb6a999654804ccb86d0ca1dc57827a7cd78afd10c80cd832d.png] 

**Thus, Only in KIO the difference between the position value between letters is different.**

Hence, "KIO" is the correct answer.
